artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.medium: woodcut with hand-coloring in blue, green, brown, tan, ocher, olive, and pale blue with gold leaf on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows three figures in a religious scene. The central figure is attached to a cross, with arms spread out horizontally. He has a beard and long hair, with a crown of thorns placed on his head. His facial expression is solemn with his head slightly tilted to the side. He is clothed in a simple drape around his waist, and there is a halo behind his head. On either side of him are two other figures. The figure on the left is draped in a blue robe and holding a book, with a halo visible. The figure on the right is dressed in robes of green and brown, has curly hair, and also a halo. This person is holding a book and looking up at the central figure. Skulls and rocks can be seen at the base of the cross. The background consists of a blank surface with a suggestion of simple rounded hills behind the figures.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in blue, light blue, ocher, green, red, tan, and cinnamon
artworks.description: The image shows a central figure hanging from a wooden cross with two other figures standing on either side. The central figure has arms outstretched along the crossbeam, head tilted downward, a crown of thorns, closed eyes, a beard, and short dark hair. The central figure is minimally clothed with a cloth around the waist. The figures on either side have halos. On the left, a figure wears a blue cloak over a draped garment, with hands clasped in front and a serene expression. On the right, the figure has curly blonde hair, wears a long cloak over a tunic, and has hands clasped together. The background depicts a pastoral scene with a blue and white sky and green ground.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross Between the Virgin and Saint John
artworks.medium: woodcut on laid paper, hand-colored with watercolor and gouache and gold leaf
artworks.description: The image displays three figures. The central figure is on a cross, with arms outstretched and head slightly tilted to the right. This person has long, dark hair, a beard, a crown of thorns, and minimal clothing. The figures on either side are seen in three-quarter views. The figure on the left is wearing a blue cloak over a pink robe and head covering, with a pale complexion and looking downward. The figure on the right is wrapped in a pink draped garment with a green undergarment visible, curly blond hair, and looking upwards. Both side figures have halos. In the background, there is a landscape with hills, buildings, clouds in the sky, and at the base of the cross, there are bones and a skull.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in blue, light blue, green, red lake, brown, and tan on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows three figures in a stylized, illustrative manner. The central figure is on a wooden cross, with a sign reading "INRI" above him. To the left stands a woman in a blue cloak with a halo, and to the right stands a man with curly hair, a halo, and a book in his hand. The background has a two-tone sky with subtle shading.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red lake, yellow, brown, and green on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts three figures. In the center, a figure is in a crucified position on a cross with arms outstretched. This figure wears a crown of thorns, dark hair falling to the shoulder, and a cloth around the waist. On the left, a figure stands with hands clasped in prayer, wearing a robe and a hooded cloak with closed eyes. On the right, a figure holds an open book, looking down, wearing robes with curly hair falling to the shoulders. All figures have halos around their heads. The background is plain, emphasizing the figures.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in blue, green, lavender, yellow, brown, red, and orange on laid paper
artworks.description: Three individuals gather around a wooden cross. The central figure is depicted affixed to the cross, with outstretched arms bound to the crossbeam. This individual has a somber expression, closed eyes, a beard, long dark hair, and wears a cloth around the waist. A crown of thorns is placed upon their head, with marks of injury and blood visible on the body. To the left, a figure in a hooded robe holds what appears to be a book. To the right, another figure in a robe holds a book as well. At the base of the cross lies a skull and several bones on the ground. The background shows fields extending to a horizon meeting a blue sky, with trees and a small building in the distance.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red, light blue, and gray on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. The drawing depicts a central figure on a cross, surrounded by two other figures. One figure is draped in a long blue robe with a halo, while the other is in white with a red interior and halo, standing with hands in a gesture of reverence. At the base of the cross, there are elements like a skull and bones, along with sparse foliage. The style suggests a print or woodcut with minimal color highlights, primarily blue and red.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in orange, yellow, olive, blue, and gold
artworks.description: The image displays three figures. One central figure is depicted on a cross with outstretched arms and legs, tilting the face to the right. The figure wears minimal clothing and has a circular halo above the head. Flanking this central figure are two other individuals, one on the left with hands clasped and a solemn expression, and one on the right holding a book. The individuals are dressed in long garments with halos above their heads. The background is simple and enclosed within a border.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in blue, orange, yellow, green, rose, gray, and tarnished silver leaf on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a crucifixion scene with two haloed figures. The image depicts a central figure on a cross, surrounded by two figures on either side. The central figure is painted with wounds and a crown of thorns. The surrounding figures are dressed in rich robes—one in blue and the other in red—standing on a green patch of ground. Their expressions seem solemn and contemplative.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.medium: hand-colored woodcut with tarnished silver (or gold alloy?) leaf on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows three figures in a medieval style. In the center, a person is on a cross. The person has mid-length hair, a crown of thorns, minimal clothing, and a cloth around their waist. On the left, a figure with a halo and flowing robe. On the right, another figure with a halo, holding what looks like a book, dressed in a cloak. Below the cross, there is a skull and a bone on the ground. The background has a blue sky, green foreground, and a red and orange frame.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in blue, red, yellow, green, gold, orange and tarnished silver (or gold alloy?) leaf on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows three figures, each with their full bodies displayed. In the center, a person is on a cross with outstretched arms, a beard, long hair, wearing a green headband, a dark halo, and clothing around the waist. To the left, another person looks upward, wearing a blue cloak, white inner head covering, red undergarment, and a dark halo. To the right, a third person stands with hands clasped, wearing a brown and beige garment, curly blonde hair, and a faint halo. The background includes a blue sky and a wooden plank marked with inscribed letters. A red frame borders the scene, with green ground beneath their feet.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in blue, red, vermillion, olive, green, yellow, and rose
artworks.description: This is a painting of a crucifixion scene. It depicts a central figure nailed to a cross, with blood flowing from wounds in the hands, feet, and side. On each side of the cross, there are two figures with halos. One is dressed in blue with a white veil, and the other in purple with a red mantle. The background is simple, emphasizing the scene in the foreground. The painting uses bold outlines and vibrant colors to emphasize the figures. It is in the style of Medieval religious iconography.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in blue-green, vermilion, lavender, brown, olive, and yellow
artworks.description: This is a painting of a crucifixion scene. The artwork depicts a central figure on a crucifix, flanked by two figures, each adorned with halos. The figure on the crucifix appears to be wounded, with blood depicted on the hands, feet, and side. The two flanking figures are depicted in robes, one in blue and the other in red. The background is minimalist, drawing focus to the figures. The use of strong, earthy tones along with red highlights the emotional and somber tone of the scene.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion with Saint Mary Magdalene
artworks.medium: hand-colored woodcut on vellum
artworks.description: This is a painting of a crucifixion scene with a city backdrop. The image shows a crucifix with a figure on it, displaying nail marks on the hands and feet. Around the crucifix are several figures in different postures, dressed in period garments. The city skyline in the background features buildings and towers under a blue sky. The artwork uses vivid colors and detailed linework to depict the landscape and scene. The style resembles that of a Renaissance artist focused on religious themes.

artworks.title: The Lamentation
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in brown lake, gray, rose, yellow, green, and olive
artworks.description: This is a painting depicting a religious scene. The composition centers around a cross, with several figures shown with halos. The figures are arranged around a reclining figure marked on the torso. The color palette is limited to earthy tones. Each figure wears traditional clothing of the period. In the foreground, another figure kneels with their back mostly turned. The setting is simplistic, focusing on the figures and their expressions. The style is reminiscent of early Christian religious paintings.

artworks.title: The Deposition
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in orange-red, yellow, and green
artworks.description: This is a painting of the deposition from the cross. The image features a figure being lowered from a cross by two other figures. The painting has a simple, illustrative style with bold outlines and flat areas of color. The figures are stylized with exaggerated expressions and simplified forms, wearing red garments against a muted background. The ground is decorated with simple floral patterns.

artworks.title: The Lamentation
artworks.medium: woodcut in dark brown, hand-colored in red-lake, blue, green, yellow, tan, gold, and orange
artworks.description: This is a print of a group of people with a cross in the background. Four people kneel around a central man who is lying on the ground. All four of the people are adorned with halos. The central man is nude except for a light-yellow cloth tied around his waist. He has long brown hair and a brown beard and is laying on a tan cloth. There are circular holes in his feet and hands. The four kneeling people wear long robes, two of which are red and two are blue. Underneath the robes are light tan and yellow garments. The three people on the right side wear white cloths that cover their hair, while the leftmost person, who cradles the head of the reclining man, has long, curling, blonde hair. The ground beneath the people is green, while the sky is white with blue streaks. The cross in the top right corner of the print is yellow.

artworks.title: The Lamentation
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red lake, green, tan, and ochre
artworks.description: The image shows four figures: three standing and one reclining on a light blue surface. The reclining figure is partially clothed and has a crown of thorns on their head. The standing figures have halos above their heads, with distinct facial features and hairstyles. One is leaning over the reclining figure, one has curly hair and wears a robe, and the other wears a blue garment with tied back hair. All are dressed in earthy-toned robes. In the background is a cross-like structure, and the composition is framed with a border against a muted tan background.

artworks.title: Christ Appearing to Mary Magdalene
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in maroon, orange, yellow, blue-green, mauve, and flesh on laid paper, possibly applied with stencils
artworks.description: The image features two figures in an outdoor setting. One person is kneeling, facing right, with long hair partly covered by a veil or headscarf, wearing a long robe with a cloak, holding a small jar. The other person stands facing left, one arm slightly extended towards the kneeling figure, with long hair and a beard, wearing a robe that exposes the chest. A tree separates them, with lush foliage at the top. Structures resembling buildings or towers can be seen in the background. At the bottom, there is a band of text.

artworks.title: Christ Appearing to Mary Magdalene
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in green, gray, olive, red lake, and gold
artworks.description: The figures are depicted from head to toe. One figure stands on the left, holding a staff with a cross and a banner. The other figure kneels on the ground next to the standing figure. Both figures have long hair, wear robes, and have dark haloes around their heads. The background shows a fenced area with horizontal structures, green patches, and a plain sky.

artworks.title: The Entombment
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red lake, green, yellow, tan, and orange
artworks.description: This is a painting of a scene involving a figure lying in a sarcophagus, attended by two other figures. The central figure appears to be resting in a rectangular structure. The structure is painted in a reddish tone and rests on a green base. The two figures nearby have flat, halo-like shapes. The background features simple architectural elements in yellow. The painting shows a stylized and flat representation typical of religious iconography.

artworks.title: Christ Carrying the Cross
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red lake, green, yellow, tan, and orange
artworks.description: The image shows two figures, both depicted from the waist up. The person in the foreground is positioned slightly bent forward, holding a large yellow cross over their right shoulder. This individual has long, flowing hair tinted with brown and orange hues, partially covered by a green and yellow headdress. This person is dressed in a long gray robe. The second figure, slightly behind and to the left, stands upright and wears a red garment with a yellow belt or sash. This person has short brown hair. The background consists of a light tan-colored surface with a section of green at the bottom. The illustration is bordered by a rough black outline.

artworks.title: The Flagellation
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red lake, green, yellow, tan, and orange
artworks.description: The image shows three figures depicted in an illustrative, stylized form. The central figure stands facing forward with a halo around their head. They have short, dark hair and notable features and are partially unclothed. The figure wears a yellow garment from the waist down and has red markings on their skin. Flanking the central figure are two other figures wearing tunics; one is in gray and yellow with stripes on their tunic, yellow leggings, and holding a green object, while the other wears a red tunic with beige leggings and is looking towards the central figure. In the background, there is a green patch underfoot and lines suggesting script or decoration along the top edge in dark ink.

artworks.title: Christ before Herod
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red lake, green, yellow, tan, and orange
artworks.description: The image features two stylized and colorful figures. One standing person has light-colored hair, a yellow halo, and is dressed in yellow and green. They have a mustache and prominent eyes. The seated person wears red with black accents, a yellow crown, and dark hair. Their hands are gesturing outward. The background shows a simple textured surface with vertical decorative elements at the top and a green area at the bottom.
